Open ScreenGarden after a day of usage to collect what Android can report. Missing days are unknown, never zero.
Android usually keeps about a week of detailed events. ScreenGarden saves collected daily totals locally, so a fresh install cannot reconstruct an earlier month.
Bars: screen time. Dashed line: daily goal %1$s.
